idea-plugin.name: Glyphmark
idea-plugin.description:
Live preview and structure view for .glyph files.

Opens Glyph markup in a source/preview split editor and renders it with the Glyphmark engine, styled to look like a page from the Pathfinder 2e rulebooks — the same output the Glyphmark CLI produces.

The Structure tool window outlines the document: headings nested by level, plus item, info, rule, sample and head blocks under the heading they belong to.
